title: Ants Perform Amputations and 90 Percent of Patients Survive

scenes.text: Ants perform amputations, and 90 percent of the patients survive.
When a Florida carpenter ant is hurt high on the leg, its nestmates bite the whole leg off.
Without the surgery, only about 40 percent survive. With it, about 90 percent do.
If the wound is lower on the leg, they don't cut. They clean it with their mouths instead, and 75 percent survive.
No tools. No training. An ant surgeon with a 90 percent success rate.

description:
Florida carpenter ants treat injured nestmates: a leg wound high up is amputated, and about 90 percent of those ants survive compared with about 40 percent without the cut.
For lower leg wounds they never amputate. They clean them, and 75 percent survive.
Which animal behaviour do you find the most human?
first_comment: The amputation takes about 40 minutes on average. Would you have guessed an insect could pull that off?
